papers.title_en: AutoMARS: Automatic and Scalable Multi-Agent Large Language Model Framework for Supply Chain Risk Assessment
papers.authors: Yinzhu Quan, Zefang Liu, Frederick Benaben, Benoit Montreuil
papers.evidence: 多智能体LLM框架用于供应链风险评估
papers.tldr: 供应链风险评估需整合多源异构风险并支持多地点规模化比较。AutoMARS以多智能体框架自动规划分析任务、协调专用代理并调用外部工具，融合社会经济、灾害、环境与交通等风险因素。框架通过并行化独立任务实现跨地点可扩展比较，形成结构化、系统化且可解释的综合风险评价。其贡献在于为供应链风险感知的选址评估提供端到端自动化分析流程。
papers.abstract_en: We propose AutoMARS (Automatic Multi-Agent Risk Assessment), an agentic framework for automatic and scalable comparative risk assessment in supply chain networks. The framework enables end-to-end execution of analytical workflows by automatically planning tasks, coordinating specialized agents, invoking external analytical tools, and synthesizing domain-specific results into integrated risk evaluations. AutoMARS further supports scalable risk comparison across multiple locations by parallelizing independent analytical tasks. The framework adopts a multi-domain, multi-agent, and multi-tool architecture that integrates heterogeneous risk factors from socioeconomic, disaster, environmental, and transportation domains. Through coordinated agent interactions and tool integration, AutoMARS enables structured, systematic, and interpretable comparative analysis to support supply chain risk-aware location evaluation.

papers.title_en: Agentic AI-Assisted Modeling for Production Scheduling: Assessment in Constraint Programming
papers.authors: Ángel Sánchez-Fernández, Javier Pernas-Álvarez, Diego Crespo-Pereira
papers.evidence: 通用LLM智能体从自然语言构建并实现约束规划模型
papers.tldr: 生产调度优化建模依赖专家且成本高，现有LLM自动建模多面向混合整数线性规划，而智能体研究常假设模型已存在。本文评估通用LLM以单/多智能体方式从自然语言构建并实现约束规划模型，并用MCP服务器检索求解器文档以减少幻觉。在六类工业调度问题上比较多智能体与直接调用基线，建模准确率尚可但实现是主要瓶颈。多智能体将脚本正确运行率从14.8%提升至59.3%，较简单问题达80.6%，为无任务训练的智能体建模提供证据。
papers.abstract_en: Developing optimization models for production scheduling requires substantial expert effort. Research on large language models (LLMs) has followed two directions: specialized approaches for automated modeling, mostly for mixed-integer linear programming, which often rely on dedicated training or problem-specific architectures that limit industrial deployment; and agentic artificial intelligence for operational decision support, which generally assumes that the optimization model already exists. This study bridges both directions by assessing whether general-purpose LLMs, orchestrated as agents without task-specific training, can formulate and implement constraint programming models from natural-language problem descriptions. Singleagent and multi-agent architectures are integrated with a Model Context Protocol server that provides context-aware retrieval of solver documentation to mitigate hallucinations during implementation. Both are compared with a direct LLM baseline on six industry-oriented problems covering flow-shop, job-shop, flexible job-shop and resource-constrained warehouse scheduling, using three LLMs and assessing modeling accuracy, execution success, latency and token consumption. Formulation proves largely within reach of current LLMs, whereas implementation is the main barrier. The multi-agent workflow raises the share of scripts that run correctly as generated from 14.8% with a direct LLM call to 59.3%, reaching 80.6% on the four less complex problems, while tightly coupled intralogistics models remain an open challenge.

papers.title_en: Estimating Causal Bounds from Observational Data With Neural Generative Models
papers.authors: Max Zhu, Srivathsan Amruth, Sina Akbari, Qingyuan Zhao
papers.evidence: 从观测数据估计因果界
papers.tldr: 从离散观测数据识别因果界是因果推断中的基础难题，除部分图结构有精确解析界外，一般情形仍缺乏通用求解方法。论文提出一个基于神经生成模型的估计框架，并引入新的外推流程，以更准确地从观测数据逼近因果界。在多种因果推断设定中，该框架给出的界持续比现有通用神经方法更接近真实界。作者还在可获得精确界的基准问题上完成验证，说明该方法为缺乏解析解的因果界估计提供了有效途径。
papers.abstract_en: Identifying causal bounds from discrete observational data is a fundamental problem in causal inference. While exact analytical bounds exist for certain graphs, this is not generally the case. In this paper, we introduce a framework for estimating such bounds using neural generative models together with a new extrapolation procedure to estimate these bounds more accurately. Across multiple causal inference settings, it produces bounds that are consistently closer to the true bounds than those obtained with existing general neural approaches. We validate the framework on a range of benchmark problems for which exact bounds are available.

papers.title_en: A Semi-Analytical Inference Framework for Structural Causal Models
papers.evidence: 结构因果模型的推理框架
papers.tldr: 结构因果模型中的观察、干预与反事实推理都依赖概率推断，但现有方法需转换为可处理表示或依赖生成模型近似。本文直接在SCM上做消息传递，将结构机制与概率密度统一表示在有限维函数空间，并用LOTUS矩的样条投影恢复密度、反向消息实现条件推断。随机连续SCM实验表明该方法能准确逼近蒙特卡洛参考解，且随B样条基分辨率提高而系统性改善。这为SCM提供了一种无需显式构造条件分布的半解析统一推断框架。
papers.abstract_en: Structural Causal Models (SCMs) provide a principled framework for observational, interventional, and counterfactual reasoning, all of which rely on probabilistic inference. Existing frameworks either transform SCMs into alternative tractable representations or rely on approximate inference with expressive generative models. We instead perform inference using a message passing scheme directly on the SCM by representing structural mechanisms and probability densities in a common finite-dimensional function space. Forward propagation combines a numerical realization of the Law of the Unconscious Statistician, while propagated densities are recovered by spline projection from LOTUS moments. The same representation naturally yields backward message passing for conditioning, providing a unified framework for causal inference. Using tensor-product B-spline bases, the resulting algorithm expresses inference through numerical quadrature and linear algebra without explicitly constructing conditional distributions. Experiments on randomly generated continuous SCMs demonstrate accurate approximation of Monte Carlo reference solutions and systematic improvement with increasing basis resolution.

papers.title_en: LLM-Based Exogenous World Modeling for Dynamic Scheduling
papers.authors: Ni Zhang, Haofeng Yuan, Jianan Zhou, Shiji Song, Zhiguang Cao
papers.evidence: LLM作为外生世界模型组件支撑调度决策与情景推演
papers.tldr: 动态调度需在在线派工中预判未来作业到达，决策失误会在非线性拖期目标下放大下游成本。作者将预训练LLM作为结构化世界模型的外生分量，借助afterstate分解只预测不确定的作业到达，并提出AWMP规划方法，结合信念条件派工策略与短场景推演。在动态作业车间和柔性作业车间基准上，加权拖期较八种经典优先级规则中的最优者分别降低6-21%和22-46%。该工作表明LLM可作为调度中的外生世界模型，显著提升动态环境下的调度性能。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic scheduling requires dispatching online arrivals while anticipating future jobs, as poor decisions can compound downstream costs under nonlinear tardiness objectives. We show that a pretrained large language model (LLM) can serve as the exogenous component of a structured world model, forecasting uncertain future job arrivals. Specifically, we exploit an afterstate decomposition, which separates known deterministic shop transitions from uncertain exogenous job arrivals, enabling the LLM to forecast only the latter through a compact belief representation. Building on this, we develop Afterstate World-Model Planning (AWMP), which combines an evolved, belief-conditioned dispatching strategy with short scenario-based rollouts. A surprise-triggered refresh mechanism queries the LLM only when newly observed arrivals deviate sufficiently from previous forecast, and online residual self-calibration further conditions the LLM on its recent forecast errors to handle nonstationary arrivals. Across diverse arrival distributions, AWMP reduces weighted tardiness by 6-21% on dynamic job-shop and 22-46% on flexible job-shop benchmarks, relative to the best of eight classical priority-dispatching rules.

papers.title_en: Harnessing Language Models as Optimization Modeling Agents
papers.authors: Yunxiang Luo, Xin Xu, Tianhao Chen, Zhixi Xiong, Peiqi Jiang, Fan Zhang, Wei Shao, Xuejian Gao, Yuwei Fan, Can Yang
papers.evidence: 以执行引导修订让语言模型充当优化建模智能体
papers.tldr: 大语言模型将自然语言优化问题转成求解器程序时，正确建模与实现仍难以可靠保证。作者提出OPTICYCLE与OPTISTATE两种轻量推理框架，仅用单一模型角色且无需额外训练。在九个基准、两千六百三十四道题和十一种Qwen模型上，执行引导修订一致提升宏准确率，最高增益四十九点四六个百分点。两框架在同模型对比中优于六种智能体工作流，整体上更可媲美四种后训练优化模型。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can translate natural-language optimization problems into solver programs, but reliably producing correct formulations and implementations remains challenging. Existing approaches improve optimization modeling through agentic workflows or task-specific post-training. This raises a practical question: can a lightweight harness using a single model role achieve competitive performance without additional training? We introduce OPTICYCLE and OPTISTATE, two lightweight inference harnesses for optimization modeling, and evaluate them on nine benchmarks comprising 2,634 problems using 11 Qwen variants spanning 0.6B-27B parameters. Our results show that execution-guided revision consistently improves macro accuracy over direct generation for all evaluated models, with gains of up to 49.46 percentage points. Despite their simplicity, both harnesses outperform six adapted agentic workflows in same-model comparisons and four evaluated post-trained optimization models at comparable model sizes, without additional training. Explicit formulation state provides further but model-dependent improvements, suggesting that additional structure is not universally beneficial.

papers.title_en: Foundation Models Meet Power Grid Topology for Cascade Prediction
papers.evidence: GNN与LLM融合用于拓扑上的级联故障传播预测
papers.tldr: 电力传输网络连锁故障严重程度早期预测常依赖网络特定表示，跨拓扑泛化受限。本文探索LLM与GNN互补能力，提出图-LLM融合框架：用LoRA微调LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct，并将拓扑感知图注意力Transformer与LLM经置信度门控融合。在IEEE 118与300节点系统各3万场景中，仅用前四步级联取得0.94和0.92加权F1；跨系统零样本准确率0.72，少量校准后达0.83。结果说明图结构学习结合基础模型可提升级联预测与迁移性。
papers.abstract_en: Accurate early-stage prediction of cascading failure severity is essential for assessing the vulnerability of power transmission networks. However, existing data-driven approaches often rely on network-specific representations, limiting their generalizability across power system topologies. This work investigates the complementary capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for cascading failure severity prediction. First, standalone LLM predictors are developed using a LoRA-fine-tuned LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct model with varying degrees of topological information. A hybrid Graph-LLM fusion framework is then proposed, integrating a Topology-Aware Graph Attention Transformer (TAGAT) with the LLM through confidence-gated fusion. TAGAT captures structural dependencies among transmission lines, while the LLM extracts representations from early-stage power-flow observations and aggregated cascade descriptors. The frameworks are evaluated on 30,000 simulated cascading failure scenarios for each of the IEEE 118-bus and IEEE 300-bus systems. Using only the first four cascade steps, the hybrid framework achieves weighted F1 scores of 0.94 and 0.92, respectively. In cross-system transfer from IEEE 118-bus to IEEE 300-bus, it achieves 0.72 zero-shot accuracy, improving to 0.83 with limited target-system calibration, outperforming standalone models and conventional baselines. These results show the potential of combining graph-based structural learning with foundation models to improve cascading failure severity prediction and cross-system transferability.

papers.title_en: When Protection Hurts: A Cytokine Storm Theory of Supply Chain Overreaction
papers.evidence: 供应链中断下过度反应与响应诱发损失的决策论建模
papers.tldr: 供应链韧性研究常把安全库存、备用供应商等防御行为视为有益，但疫情、芯片短缺和苏伊士堵塞显示同步囤货与重复下单会放大拥堵和成本。本文构建决策理论框架，将保护性响应强度作为内生变量，提出响应诱发损失并推导供应链细胞因子风暴阈值与指数。结果表明最优响应通常低于风暴阈值，而比例响应启发式可能越界，网络传播可由谱稳定性条件判定。研究强调韧性不仅在于缓解中断，更在于保持防御响应与冲击成比例。
papers.abstract_en: Supply chain resilience research has traditionally viewed defensive actions such as safety stock, backup suppliers, expedited transportation, and emergency sourcing as beneficial. However, disruptions such as the COVID-19 pandemic, the 2021 semiconductor shortage, and the Suez Canal blockage highlight how synchronized hoarding, duplicate ordering, and capacity reservation can amplify congestion and operational costs, sometimes worsening the original disruption. Motivated by this observation, we develop a decision-theoretic framework in which Protective Response Intensity (PRI) is an endogenous decision variable. We introduce Response-Induced Loss (RIL) to capture costs generated by defensive actions and characterize a unique optimal response that balances disruption mitigation against self-induced losses. We derive a closed-form critical response threshold beyond which RIL exceeds the original disruption intensity, a phenomenon termed a *Supply Chain Cytokine Storm*. We further propose the Cytokine Storm Index (CSI), measuring response-induced loss relative to the original disruption, and discuss its potential calibration using operational data. Extending the framework to interconnected supply networks, we derive a spectral stability condition distinguishing bounded decentralized responses from network-wide propagation. Numerical experiments show that optimal responses remain below the storm threshold, whereas proportional response heuristics can exceed it. Network responses converge or diverge according to the derived stability condition. Overall, our findings highlight that supply chain resilience depends not only on mitigating disruptions but also on keeping defensive responses proportionate to the shocks they are intended to address.

papers.title_en: Agentic AI Orchestration Framework for Spatial Intelligence: Supply Chain Deployment
papers.evidence: 部署于供应链的智能体AI编排框架
papers.tldr: 工业空间决策分散在缺乏统一参考系与责任主体的系统中，分析人员大量精力用于对账而非空间推理。ANASSA 以类型化数据契约、多智能体编排和权威空间 grounding 整合结构化推理与反馈执行，并在供应链场景落地。三个月 POC 显示数据质量提升25%、空间工作流运行时间缩短50%、决策时延降低60%。该工作给出可部署参考架构及后续机制级评估协议。
papers.abstract_en: Industrial spatial decisions are assembled across systems that share neither a reference frame nor an owner, and analysts spend substantial effort reconciling those systems rather than reasoning about space. This paper presents ANASSA, a reference architecture integrating structured reasoning, multi-agent workflow orchestration, authoritative spatial grounding, and feedback-driven execution, and reports its instantiation in an operating supply-chain deployment. The architecture places typed data contracts at agent boundaries, validates spatial claims against a certified authoritative foundation, and enforces two blocking human-in-the-loop approvals inside a six-step cognitive loop. The deployment covers multi-hazard risk assessment on an ocean-and-inland freight lane, including cold-chain excursion detection over container telemetry. Across a three-month proof of concept (POC) with three implementation iterations, three deployment outcomes are reported: 25% improvement in data quality, 50% reduction in spatial workflow runtime, and 60% lower decision latency relative to the preceding manual workflow. Absolute deployment-scale quantities and baseline counts are confidential; reported percentages are observed relative changes. These are uncontrolled deployment observations, not controlled experiments. We therefore specify instrumentation and ablation protocols for mechanism-level evaluation.

papers.title_en: Robust global supply chain reconfiguration under tariff and geopolitical uncertainty
papers.evidence: 中断下供应链重构的稳健优化
papers.tldr: 针对关税与地缘政治冲击下全球供应链重构问题，构建两阶段鲁棒优化框架，将供应商资格与运输弧启用作为先期决策，运营流在不确定性实现后调整。模型用国家级冲击联合刻画关税升级、跨境运力限制、设施中断与运输失效，并通过对偶化与列约束生成求解非凸混合整数双线性对抗问题。实验表明忽略地缘政治传导通道会显著恶化成本与服务，保护主要来自运输网络配置而非增加供应商资格；跨境运力限制影响强于同比例关税变化。
papers.abstract_en: Global supply chains are increasingly exposed to trade policy shocks and physical disruptions arising from common geopolitical events. We develop a robust optimization framework with two decision stages for strategic supply chain reconfiguration. Supplier qualification and transportation arc activation decisions are made before uncertainty is realized, while operational flows adapt afterward. Geopolitical uncertainty is represented through country level shocks that can jointly trigger tariff escalation, policy induced restrictions on cross border capacity, facility disruptions, and physical transportation failures. The resulting min max min problem is reformulated by dualizing the operational recourse problem, yielding a nonconvex mixed integer bilinear adversarial problem solved within a column and constraint generation procedure. Comparison with complete enumeration verifies the implementation on small instances, while experiments on 60 synthetic supply chain networks of varying sizes assess computational performance. The results show that omitting geopolitical transmission channels during strategic design can lead to substantial deterioration in cost and service under full geopolitical stress. Broader protection is achieved primarily through changes in transportation network configuration rather than increased supplier qualification. Robust performance also depends on the severity and composition of geopolitical consequences, with restrictions on cross border capacity exerting a stronger effect than comparable proportional changes in tariff severity over the tested ranges. A geographically grounded case analysis further shows that the value of individual uncertainty channels depends on network structure and geographic exposure.
